name: Garnier Vitamin C Serum Cream SPF 25
description:
Garnier Skinactive Vitamin C 2-in-1 Brightening Serum Cream Is A 2-in-1 Product Consisting Of 20% Concentrated Serum And A Face Cream. This Weightless Formula Works On Lightening Tired Skin, Uneven Skin And Reducing Dark Circles.

The Formula Is Enriched With Vitamin C, Which, Among Other Things, Leaves The Skin With Beautiful Glow And A Healthy Radiance In Just Three Days ! In Addition, The Product Contains Spf25 , Which Protects The Skin From Uva / Uvb Rays.

Try Garnier Skinactive Vitamin C 2-in-1 Brightening Serum Cream, Which Renews Your Skin In No Time.
